summary.text: Walter Hudson is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 30A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously worked as an operations manager, a radio show host and an associate editor.

paragraphs.text: Walter Hudson lives in Albertville, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. in information technology from the University of Phoenix.

His career experience includes working as an operations manager for a logistics company, as a radio show host with Twin Cities News Talk AM 1130, and as an associate editor with the David Horowitz Freedom Center.
Hudson assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Paul Novotny.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education Finance, Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and Fraud Prevention and State Agency Oversight Policy committees, and he is co-vice chair of the Judiciary Finance and Civil Law Committee.
